trajectory.thought: The leader (trimmed_mean on pool3) is a seeded baseline and the verdict is "indistinguishable" — the runner-up is not statistically better. With only 3 validation windows, fitted weights are high-variance (as confirmed by w1's poor score of 0.458), and the robust trimmed mean over the 9 most stable models already captures the top cluster while discarding the tail of poor performers. This is the right stopping point.

action_args.justification: The series is strongly trend-dominated (trend strength 0.97) with no seasonality and moderate ranking stability (Kendall tau 0.41). The top 9 models form a tight cluster (RMSE 109–164) while the remaining 11 jump to a median of 544, so a trimmed mean over the stable top-9 pool naturally discards the unreliable tail. With only 3 validation windows, fitted weights (w1, score 0.458) are too noisy to beat a robust combiner. The leader is a seeded baseline and the runner-up margin is statistically indistinguishable, so accepting is the correct call.
